name: cowin_register_beneficiary
description: Registers a new beneficiary in the CoWIN system using identity proof. This is the first step before any vaccination-related action. It does not log the user in or generate a session_token (use cowin_login_beneficiary for authentication).

name: cowin_login_beneficiary
description: Authenticates a beneficiary using mobile OTP and returns a session_token required for all authenticated tools. Must be called before cowin_book_appointment, cowin_cancel_appointment, cowin_download_certificate, cowin_request_international_certificate, cowin_raise_issue, and cowin_track_issue_status. It does not register a new user.

name: cowin_check_vaccination_status
description: Checks vaccination status (dose history) for a beneficiary_ref_id. Must be called before cowin_download_certificate to ensure at least one dose is recorded. It does not download certificates or modify records.

beneficiary_ref_id.description: Unique reference ID assigned to the beneficiary during registration. Used to identify which registered person the action applies to (up to 4 per mobile number).

name: cowin_find_vaccination_centres
description: Finds vaccination centres based on location and filters like vaccine type and fee type. Must be called before cowin_check_slot_availability to obtain centre_id. It does not show slot availability or allow booking.

name: cowin_check_slot_availability
description: Checks available vaccination slots for a given centre_id and date. Must be called before cowin_book_appointment because booking requires a session_id from this step. It does not book appointments.

centre_id.description: ID of vaccination centre obtained from cowin_find_vaccination_centres

name: cowin_book_appointment
description: Books a vaccination appointment using a session_id from cowin_check_slot_availability. Must be called after cowin_login_beneficiary and cowin_check_slot_availability. Returns appointment_id required for cancellation. It does not check slot availability itself.

session_token.description: Token returned by cowin_login_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

beneficiary_ref_id.description: Unique reference ID assigned to the beneficiary during registration. Used to identify which registered person the action applies to (up to 4 per mobile number).

session_id.description: Session ID from slot availability check

name: cowin_cancel_appointment
description: Cancels an existing vaccination appointment using appointment_id obtained from cowin_book_appointment. Must be called after cowin_login_beneficiary and cowin_book_appointment. It does not create or modify appointments.

session_token.description: Token returned by cowin_login_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

beneficiary_ref_id.description: Unique reference ID assigned to the beneficiary during registration. Used to identify which registered person the action applies to (up to 4 per mobile number).

name: cowin_download_certificate
description: Downloads vaccination certificate for a beneficiary. Must be called after cowin_login_beneficiary and cowin_check_vaccination_status to ensure dose is recorded. It does not check vaccination status itself.

session_token.description: Token returned by cowin_login_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

beneficiary_ref_id.description: Unique reference ID assigned to the beneficiary during registration. Used to identify which registered person the action applies to (up to 4 per mobile number).

name: cowin_request_international_certificate
description: Requests an international travel vaccination certificate. Must be called after cowin_login_beneficiary. It does not download the standard certificate (use cowin_download_certificate for that).

session_token.description: Token returned by cowin_login_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

beneficiary_ref_id.description: Unique reference ID assigned to the beneficiary during registration. Used to identify which registered person the action applies to (up to 4 per mobile number).

name: cowin_raise_issue
description: Raises an issue related to vaccination such as certificate errors or missing dose records. Must be called after cowin_login_beneficiary. Returns request_id required for tracking. It does not track issues (use cowin_track_issue_status for that).

session_token.description: Token returned by cowin_login_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

beneficiary_ref_id.description: Unique reference ID assigned to the beneficiary during registration. Used to identify which registered person the action applies to (up to 4 per mobile number).

name: cowin_track_issue_status
description: Tracks the status of an issue raised using request_id from cowin_raise_issue. Must be called after cowin_login_beneficiary and cowin_raise_issue. It does not raise new issues.

session_token.description: Token returned by cowin_login_beneficiary. Required for all authenticated tools. Not required for the 4 public tools listed above.

beneficiary_ref_id.description: Unique reference ID assigned to the beneficiary during registration. Used to identify which registered person the action applies to (up to 4 per mobile number).

request_id.description: Request ID returned when issue was raised
